<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex47012026-03-0314-24-44" status="unreviewed">dang po ni <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3839">rtsang</rs></note> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3839">kha 1</rs> na re tshad ma sgro 'dogs kyi yul rdzas 1 ldog pa tha dad do zhes zer 'di mi rigs te de ltar na sgra rtag mi rtag rdzas 1 rtu 'gyur tshad ma dang sgro 'dogs kyi yul yin pa'i phyir | | s2a pa dang lugs li | khyed rang ji ltar 'dod na tshad ma dang sgro 'dogs 2 dmyigs yul 1 la 'jug 'dzin stangs kyi yul tha dad
               <lb n="24a6"/>pa yin pas skyon gang yang med do | | 
               2 pa brtsad pa spang pa la 2 las brtsad pa ni sgra rtag 'dzin gyi dmigs yul sgya yin na dung ser 'dzin gyi gzung yul yang dung yin dung la ser po med pas ser 'dzin gyi gzung yul dung yin par 'gal byas pa la | sgra la rtag pa med pas rtag 'dzin gyi dmigs yul sgyu yin par 'gal zar na sgro 'dogs 'khrul nas sgra 'a
               <lb n="24a7"/>pa la rtag par gzung zhes bya | ser 'dzin 'khrul nas dkar po la ser por gzung zhe na | su pa de sel ba'i lan ni di ltar du de chos can ser 'dzin gyi shes pa la snang bar 'gyur de'i gzung yul yin pa'i phyir zhes bya | rtag 'dzin gyi sgro 'dogs kyi sgra nges par thal dmigs yul yin pa'i phyir zhe na 'dod pa yin | 'dir yang 'dod na dkar po yang snang bar thal
               <lb n="24a8"/>snang ba'i dung dang rdzas 1 pa'i phyir | 'o na mi rtag pa yang nges par thal sgra dang rdzas 1 pa'i phyir ro zhe na | ma nges te sgra ma yin du 'dzin pa'i sgro 'dogs chod la rtag 'dzin gyi sgros dogs ma chod pa'i phyir | 'dir yang de skad smra na snang la ma nges pa rgyun chad du thal | nges la sgro 'dogs ma chod pa rgyun chad du thal zhe na 'dod pa yin | ser 'dzin gyi shes pa la
               <lb n="24a9"/>dkar po snang bar thal ba 'dod tdog byed na ser 'dzin yin pa nyaMs so | |</seg></TEI>
